narrative.overview: HAMLET reads like an editorial about arriving somewhere real. Every page opens on a forest band: the title, its context and the tabs, set in heavy Inter with one soft Playfair phrase that carries the feeling. Below it, the work happens on ivory paper: real interiors, plain facts, one clear action. The pacing is a magazine's (numbered sections, captioned photographs, generous air), but the job is practical: a guest on a phone, on mobile data, should see a real place, its all-in price and the way to request it within seconds.
keyCharacteristics: Dark opens, light works: forest band on top, ivory working area below.
Two-voice headlines: a heavy Inter statement, then one Playfair phrase.
Numbered editorial labels on public pages; plain labels in workspaces.
Photography leads; captions sit on a dark gradient.
One loud action per view, in blue.
Mobile first: the hero, its action and the first listing fit the first screen.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: One blue button per view. A second action is ghost or a link; two blue buttons side by side is a bug.

rules.name: The Lime Stays Dark Rule
rules.body: Lime is a fill behind forest text or an accent on forest. Lime or coral text on ivory at body size is forbidden.

rules.name: The Retired Colours Rule
rules.body: The old navy (#0e1f3b) and gold (#c9a44a) never return, including in the logo, favicon, share artwork and footer.

rules.name: The One Serif Phrase Rule
rules.body: Each headline gets exactly one Playfair phrase. Two serif phrases in one heading dilute the voice.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing on any page is smaller than 11px. Form fields are 16px on phones so iOS never zooms.

rules.name: The First Screen Rule
rules.body: On a 390×844 phone and a 1366×768 laptop, the hero, its primary action and (on Stays) the first listing are visible without scrolling. Decorative band photos are skipped on phones and never downloaded.

rules.name: The Results First Rule
rules.body: On listing pages, results come before exploration (neighbourhood rails, guides).

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No card has a shadow at rest. A shadow means "this floats" or "you are touching this".

dos: Do open every page with the forest band and set the title as one heavy statement plus one Playfair phrase.
Do use exactly one blue action per view and make it reachable on the first phone screen.
Do show "fees included" next to every guest price and itemise the refundable caution deposit separately.
Do keep text at 11px or larger, contrast at 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24px+), touch targets at 44px and form fields at 16px on phones.
Do use real listing photos and real states; show an honest empty state when there is nothing yet.
Do reveal sections once on scroll (rise 26px, fade, 700ms, 80ms grid stagger) and stop all of it under reduced motion except the ticker and stamp.
donts: Don't use navy (#0e1f3b), gold (#c9a44a), stock illustrations or icons as hero art.
Don't put lime or coral text on ivory at body size.
Don't add shadows to cards at rest or stack cards inside cards.
Don't show placeholder homes, invented reviews, ratings or availability.
Don't add buttons for features that do not exist yet (share, save, map) as decoration.
Don't let a phone page bury its first listing or booking action below decorative content.
